subject: Packaging and pricing for retention, tracing, dashboards — Stratus Health
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Liu <jordan.liu@stratushealth.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-04T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Options for observability add-ons (retention / tracing / dashboards)

Jordan — great to meet last week. Per our conversation, attached is a concise set of options for the observability add-ons you asked about: long-term retention buckets, distributed tracing (span ingestion + storage), and the advanced dashboards pack. I focused on packaging that lets you trade committed ingestion/seat commitments for a blended discount rather than forcing a single billing dimension.

High-level options attached: a) Pay-as-you-go (metered) with 10% pilot credit b) Committed ingestion tiers (3/12 month) with stepped discounts c) Hybrid: commit to a baseline ingestion + seat-based dashboards with a deeper discount and a one-time migration credit.

Quick asks from our side so we can tighten pricing:
- Expected average daily span volume (approx) and retention target (30/90/365 days)
- Number of dashboards and active end-users (viewer vs editor)
- Any procurement constraints on start-of-month billing or PO requirements

Attached: stratus-retention-estimate.csv (sample ingest projections) and dashboard-mockup-v2.png (UI concept that maps to seat types). I put a conservative bucket in row 2 of the CSV — if you send a short sample from your ops team I can re-run numbers early tomorrow.

Goal: get you a numeric commercial that shows: monthly unit price, committed discount tier, proposed pilot credits, and an SOW draft link. If that looks good I can loop in Legal to fast-track SOW edits.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

Attachment: stratus-retention-estimate.csv (CSV, 14 KB)
Attachment: dashboard-mockup-v2.png (PNG, 220 KB)

From: Jordan Liu <jordan.liu@stratushealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@stratushealth.com, Marta Brooks <marta.brooks@stratushealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Options for observability add-ons (retention / tracing / dashboards)

Naomi — thanks for the quick follow. A few clarifications from our side:
- We plan to ingest ~1.2M spans/day initially, expecting that to grow to ~3M within 6 months.
- Retention target: 90 days for full fidelity, with selective 365-day cold storage for key datasets.
- Dashboards: ~15 editors, ~120 viewers. The dashboards are a mix of operational (low-latency) and historical reporting.
- Procurement: standard PO process, 60-day net; our legal prefers a single contract covering hosted + add-ons rather than separate SOWs if possible.

On discounts: we need to understand the blended unit economics — a single percent across the board is easier for our CFO to evaluate. Also curious if you can offer any one-time migration credit or pilot pricing while we validate ROI.

Jordan
Head of Infrastructure, Stratus Health
jordan.liu@stratushealth.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Liu <jordan.liu@stratushealth.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-04T14:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Options for observability add-ons (retention / tracing / dashboards)

Jordan — thanks for the numbers, that helps a lot. I ran three packaging scenarios and attached a concise table in the body below to keep things scannable. I also uploaded a draft SOW (link in footer) that binds the hosted service + add-ons into a single contract per your preference.

Summary pricing (monthly, USD) — approximations based on your 1.2M -> 3M span ramp: 
- Metered Pilot (0 commitment): base span ingest $0.0009/span; dashboards licensed per seat (editor $35/month, viewer $6/month); 10% pilot credit for first 60 days. Estimated first-month: $1,100 (pilot).
- Committed Tier (12-month, baseline 1.5M spans/day): blended unit $0.00055/span; dashboards seats included for up to 20 editors + 100 viewers; 20% discount on advanced visual add-ons; estimated monthly: $2,450 (predictable).
- Hybrid (3-month commit to 1M spans/day + seat commitment for dashboards): blended unit $0.00065/span; one-time migration credit $12,000 applied over first three invoices; estimated monthly: $1,750 after credit amortization.

Key tradeoffs: the committed 12-month gives the lowest long-term per-span price and includes dashboard seats; the hybrid minimizes near-term cash outlay while still giving a meaningful effective discount via the migration credit.

I attached an updated stratus-retention-estimate.csv with the three scenarios in separate tabs and a short model of monthly cash flow. If you'd like, I can convert this into a single-page commercial that shows ARR impact for finance.

If these look directionally right, Ben (CC) can propose a final commercial concession band and I will spin the SOW into DocuSign.

Thanks,
Naomi

Attachment: stratus-retention-estimate.csv (CSV, 22 KB)
Related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d-stratus-proposal

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Jordan Liu <jordan.liu@stratushealth.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-05T09:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Options for observability add-ons (retention / tracing / dashboards)

Jordan / Naomi — reviewed Naomi's scenarios. We're comfortable offering an additional commercial concession to bridge the CFO ask for a single blended percentage:
- If Stratus signs a 12-month committed ingestion at >=1.5M spans/day, we can move the blended unit to $0.00050/span (an additional ~9% off Naomi's committed scenario) and include the 20 dashboard editor seats at no extra per-seat charge.
- One-time migration credit: we can increase to $15,000 if Stratus executes within 21 days of proposal delivery. Credit applied across invoices 1–3.

Constraints to call out (internal): billing needs PO with 60-day net, finance may request a security attestation addendum for HIPAA-adjacent data policy (we already provide SOC2; will coordinate with Security).

Naomi — please use the revised blended unit and credit levels in the updated SOW. Jordan — happy to jump on a quick call if you want to walk through the math with your CFO.

Ben Carter
Director, Commercials — Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Liu <jordan.liu@stratushealth.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-06T10:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Options for observability add-ons (retention / tracing / dashboards)

Jordan — short technical notes to make sure the commercial maps to your ops expectations:
- Retention tiers: we support hot retention (30/90 days) with automatic cold tiering. Cold storage uses quantized snapshots; restore times for 365-day cold are typically in the 4–12 hour window depending on dataset size.
- Span ingestion: our recommended buffer for 3M/day peaks is a 2.5x burst headroom and a 48-hour ingest buffer to avoid backpressure in the first 90 days. That is factored into the committed tier sizing Naomi used.
- Dashboards: editor seats include query concurrency of 6 QPS; viewer seats are limited to cached reads. If you plan heavy ad-hoc analysis we should expand editors or add a compute addon.

Attachment: SOW_Stratus_v1.docx (DOCX, 38 KB) — Naomi, updated to reflect Ben's concession and the single-contract preference. Jordan, please flag any legal redlines; legal will try to accommodate the PO and net-60 billing clauses.

Kimberly Park
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Options for observability add-ons (retention / tracing / dashboards)

Team — thanks for the clear options and the concession. Our CFO reviewed the blended-unit approach and the increased migration credit makes this much easier to model. Two final items before we sign:
1) Confirm we get the blended $0.00050/span for a 12-month commit at >=1.5M spans/day (as Ben wrote).
2) We need the SOW to include explicit language on cold restore SLAs (4–12 hours) and a statement about data residency in US regions.

If both are confirmed, we will move to internal approval and issue a PO within 10 business days. Please mark the SOW as final and send the DocuSign link.

Jordan
Head of Infrastructure, Stratus Health
